rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when the motive is simply the reason someone acted.

example.english: There must be a motive behind what you did.
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 zou6 jat1 ding6 jau5 jyun4 jan1

rows.note: Use this for the underlying personal reason or emotion prompting an action, especially in serious or analytical contexts.

example.english: The police are still investigating his motive for committing the crime.
example.traditional: 警方仲調查緊佢犯案嘅動機。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 zung6 tiu4 caa4 gan2 keoi5 faan6 on3 ge3 dung6 gei1

rows.note: Use this when suggesting that someone has a hidden, self-serving, or possibly dishonest motive.

example.english: I don't know what ulterior motive they have.
example.jyutping: m4 zi1 keoi5 jau5 me1 sam1 gei1
